# onetsolutions_projects (Data Source)

Lists the projects of an organization the API key's user can access.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "onetsolutions_projects" "all" {}

output "project_ids" {
  value = { for project in data.onetsolutions_projects.all.projects : project.name => project.id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `organization_id` (String) The organization to read from. Defaults to the provider's `organization_id`.

### Read-Only

- `projects` (Attributes List) The projects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--projects))

<a id="nestedatt--projects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `projects`

Read-Only:

- `domain_quota` (Number) The number of domains the project may hold.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the project.
- `name` (String) The name of the project.
